meta.title: OSF and Batory money to the 8 judges (grant-record sweep)
meta.method: Read Stefan Batory Foundation annual reports 2002-2025 grant tables, its Legal Experts Team lists, EEA Grants and Active Citizens project pages, and OSF award listings. Grant lines quoted from the reports were checked twice. Gaps: 2004 report not read; the OSF grants database blocks automated reading.
meta.summary: No OSF or Batory payment to any of the 8 judges personally. Indirect fact ties: Markiewicz (Iustitia grants 2019 and 2022-24; KOS; Archive council), Korwin-Piotrowska (Themis 2014-16), Patyra (Hołda Association/KOS), Taborowski (Archive council). Bentkowska, Dziurda, Szostek, Berek: nothing found.

leads.lead: Batory money reached the judges' organisations
leads.result: Fact, indirect: Iustitia (Markiewicz) got Batory grants in 2002, 2007, 2019 and 2022-24; Themis (Korwin-Piotrowska) in 2014-16; Hołda Association/KOS (Patyra, Iustitia) PLN 300,000 in 2018-20; Osiatyński Archive (Markiewicz, Taborowski) PLN 400,000 in 2017-18. No payment to any judge personally.
leads.label: fact

leads.lead: That Batory money was Soros/OSF money
leads.result: Mixed. OSF co-funded the 2017-18 programme that paid KOS and the Archive (fact). The 2019 Iustitia grant came from Batory own funds, 1% tax and the Polish Business Council; the 2014-16 Themis and 2022-24 Iustitia grants were EEA/Norway money. The 2007 Iustitia grant may have been OSF money (Batory was mostly OSF-funded then) but no line says so.
